title: Progressive Learning from Content to Relevance to Personalization for CTR Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.29138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal click-through rate (CTR) prediction is central to search systems, where ranking depends on item content, query relevance, and user preference. Existing approaches incorporate content through dense embeddings or coarse discrete IDs, yet effectively integrating fine-grained heterogeneous content with ID-based predictors remains challenging. We propose FineSID, a progressive learning framework that unifies content tokenization, query--item semantic pretraining, and personalized post-training via a shared fine-grained discrete representation. Each stage optimizes an explicit objective while preserving token-level access to content. First, a pretrained multi-scale visual tokenizer and text tokenizers convert heterogeneous content into fine-grained Semantic IDs (SIDs), explicitly aligning them with the ID features. Second, full-parameter semantic pretraining under query--item relevance supervision establishes a robust matching prior

translated_title: 面向CTR预测的从内容到相关性再到个性化的渐进式学习
translated_abstract: 多模态点击率（CTR）预测是搜索系统的核心，其排序取决于物品内容、查询相关性和用户偏好。现有方法通过稠密嵌入或粗粒度离散ID来融入内容信息，然而如何有效地将细粒度异构内容与基于ID的预测器相结合仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了FineSID，这是一个渐进式学习框架，通过共享的细粒度离散表示，统一了内容分词、查询-物品语义预训练和个性化后训练。每个阶段都优化一个明确的目标，同时保留对内容的token级访问。首先，预训练的多尺度视觉分词器和文本分词器将异构内容转换为细粒度的语义ID（SIDs），并将其与ID特征显式对齐。其次，在查询-物品相关性监督下进行全参数语义预训练，建立鲁棒的匹配先验。
tldr: 提出FineSID渐进式学习框架，通过共享的细粒度语义ID表示统一内容分词、查询-物品相关性语义预训练和个性化后训练，有效解决多模态CTR预测中细粒度异构内容与ID预测器融合的难题。
en_tdlr: FineSID is a progressive learning framework that unifies content tokenization, query-item relevance pretraining, and personalized post-training through shared fine-grained Semantic IDs to effectively integrate heterogeneous content with ID-based CTR predictors.
